title: Ivo and the Orbit
author: Xanthe Eastwick
blurb: Jonah Marchetti, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
